Class SlotScreenDispatcher

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotScreenDispatcher
@Internal public final class SlotScreenDispatcher extends Object
The §0042 firewall between MenuKit's registered-slot screen dispatch and MenuKit-Containers' registered-slot work.

MenuKit's mixins on AbstractContainerScreen (render / hover / click / scroll / release) call the static fire* methods here. This class holds the one SlotScreenHook MenuKit-Containers registers at client init and forwards to it — or no-ops when no hook is set (MK-only consumer: no slots exist, so nothing to dispatch). MenuKit thus drives the per-screen dispatch while never naming a registered-slot type.

Stateless beyond the single hook reference; the hook is volatile so the client-init write is visible to the render thread. There is no init() — the dispatch is the mixins themselves, which exist as soon as the class loads; registration is a single setHook(SlotScreenHook) call.
